rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Swept all six chunks. Chunk 0's 'the right window' reads as the terminal session pane (multiple Claude Code windows open), locally resolvable and distinct from the later context-window usage established by the same chunk's 'The point: the context window is not your codebase.' Chunk 1's 'you point it' resolves to 'a cold agent' in the same sentence. Chunk 3's 'it'/'its' resolve to Claude, named repeatedly in prior chunks. Chunk 4's 'the window' resolves to the context window named in chunk 0. Chunk 5's 'the slice Claude didn't load' was named in chunk 2 ('the files Claude didn't load') and is arc-earned within this file. No never-named, vague-with-history, or re-chunk-stranded referent found.
No chunk points at another file or an unnamed earlier slide by position. The ccstatusline/`/statusline` mentions in chunk 4 are named capabilities, not positional callbacks.

rules_evaluated.evidence: The body carries no 'the X you did/saw' backward beat reference; the only arc pointers ('Picks up from', 'Hands off to') sit in the maintainer block, out of body scope.

Could be more or less than this heuristic suggests' is a number-plus-retraction shape but is maintainer-attested as the deliberate teaching shape (working prior held loosely) — accept-with-note per this file's standing attestation, not re-filed.
